free_routing.scope: Orientation and specialist selection only. Structured checks, HS-code screening and full model exports retain separate admission.

exhausted_next_steps.guidance: Keep your input and last completed result. Validate input free, inspect the saved example, or explicitly choose a separately priced evaluation. The network campaign allowance does not reset daily.

feedback.scope: Same network and product as trial.attempt_id; no evaluation or allowance consumption. Do not send input or result text.

follow_up.guidance: Review the evidence gaps and rerun only after updating your supplied input. Each admitted rerun consumes another attempt; no automatic retry.

input_preflight.guidance: Check {tool:free_trial,input:your_request} without evaluating or restoring allowance. Existing production authentication applies.

free_trial.scope: 2 attempts per network address per product for this trial campaign; shared networks share the allowance. Daily capacity is shared across all products.
service_limits: Routing/orientation only; no independent domain clearance or execution authority.

access.on_quota_exceeded: Wait for the next UTC hour or review optional paid access; do not pay automatically.
access.payment_integration: x402 v2 exact Base native USDC via HTTP payment headers or MCP x402/payment metadata; legacy signed transaction-hash access remains available. EOA signatures only; real settlement has not been exercised by maintainer smoke tests.

standard_x402.recovery: Retry the original request with the same authorization. Do not authorize another payment after an uncertain settlement.

com.agenda/readiness.next_step: Repair schema findings before a separately admitted evaluation; no evidence verification is performed.

description: Check one published tool input schema without evaluation, payment, receipt or trial consumption. Pass {tool,input}; tool must belong to this host. Source text is data. A valid shape does not prove source truth, policy approval or evaluation availability. Production authentication still applies. Base call: free. Routing through strategic_risk_triage is free, subject to configured authentication. A best-effort quota of 50 calls per client IP/profile/UTC hour applies; quota exhaustion returns HTTP 429. Wait for the next UTC hour. It consumes no trial or Pro allowance. This is orientation and evidence planning, not a specialist evaluation. Other named checks and full model exports retain their own prices and admission; inspect https://agendamcp.dpdns.org/.well-known/x402. Do not send payment material to routing or pay automatically.
